faqs.question: Are these carpet tiles nylon or polypropylene?
faqs.answer: Both variants listed here have a 100% polypropylene (PP) face, as confirmed for this product selection. They are not listed as nylon. Match the chosen design and construction to the approved physical sample and quotation.

faqs.question: Do both patterns have the same thickness?
faqs.answer: No. The gray cloud variant is about 6 mm thick; the black-gray geometric variant is listed at 5.4 mm. Keep the two specifications separate and confirm the installed floor build-up and transitions with the installer.

faqs.question: Are the size, backing and performance ratings shared?
faqs.answer: No shared size, backing, weight or performance rating is asserted here. Ask for the specification sheet for the selected variant. Fire, VOC, traffic and chair-use evidence must match that exact construction and intended installation.

faqs.question: Are these photographs of supplied products or completed offices?
faqs.answer: No. All seven images are AI-edited design illustrations based on supplied appearance references. Room scenes and layout views are planning concepts, not completed client projects or technical evidence. Approve a physical sample for actual colour and texture.

faqs.question: What is the FOB price and shipment port?
faqs.answer: FOB price: Request a project quotation. FOB port: tianjingang (Tianjin Port, China). Include the selected pattern, area, destination, required documents and delivery window. Confirm unit, quantity, packing, MOQ and lead time in the written quotation.
